narrative.Overview: Create the foundational repo structure: Taskfile, .gitignore, CHANGELOG.md, directory layout, and top-level config stubs. No service implementation — this scope establishes the skeleton every subsequent scope builds on.
narrative.Traces: FR-10 (.env.example stub), NFR-4 (.gitignore for secrets + .env), NFR-5 (.example file convention established)

items.title: Create directory layout
items.description: Create top-level directories: configs/, data/, docs/, scripts/, tests/. Add .gitkeep where needed so dirs are tracked. data/ must be gitignored.

items.title: Taskfile.yml with core tasks
items.description: Add Taskfile.yml with tasks: default (task --list), up (docker compose up -d), up:proxy (docker compose --profile proxy up -d), down, logs, check (lint + test), test, test:integration, fmt. Include desc for every task.

items.title: .gitignore
items.description: Gitignore: data/, .env, secrets/*.env (not *.example), *.premigrate.*, caddy_data/, forgejo_data/ bind-mount dirs if used.

items.title: CHANGELOG.md
items.description: Create CHANGELOG.md following Keep a Changelog format with an [Unreleased] section and a 0.1.0 placeholder.

items.title: .env.example stub
items.description: Create .env.example with section headers (GLOBAL, PROXY MODE, HIGH-VOLUME TWEAKS) and placeholder values for all variables defined in FR-10. Every variable must have an inline comment. Actual values must not be filled in.

items.title: secrets/ directory with .example templates
items.description: Create secrets/ dir with .gitignore (ignore everything except *.example) and any .example template files needed (e.g. github-token.example).
